author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Whitening Tau Sweep (tau=0.85)
abstract: This experiment is part of a hyperparameter sweep on the whitening tau parameter in the Praxis SOTA pipeline. This run tests a lower value (tau=0.85) compared to the baseline of 0.95 to assess score sensitivity.
